title: MISA-AKMC : Achieve Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulation of 20 Quadrillion Atoms on GPU Clusters
problem: Atomic Kinetic Monte Carlo requires massive memory for large-scale simulations; porting to GPUs faces memory pressure and communication overhead scaling limitations
motivation: AKMC enables materials science discovery at atomistic scale; enabling micrometer-scale simulations (quadrillion atoms) could unlock new materials insights
method: GPU cluster implementation with Lattice Data Compression and Vacancy Decompression algorithms; multi-level pipeline with on-demand communication merging reduces data transfer
key_novelty: First true micrometer-scale AKMC simulation on GPU clusters (20 quadrillion atoms); introduces data compression strategies for memory-constrained GPU execution
contributions: Lattice data compression and vacancy decompression algorithms
52.07x simulation scale expansion enabling quadrillion-atom simulations
96.03% weak scaling, 85.29% strong scaling on 16K GPUs
limitations: GPU-specific memory layout requirements; inter-GPU communication overhead not fully characterized; materials classes supported not detailed
